name: Thai Kitchen Organic Lite Coconut Milk (Canned)
whyItWorks: Made from pure pressed coconut meat blended with filtered water (60% less fat than regular coconut milk). Contains easily assimilated Medium Chain Triglycerides (MCTs), zero lactose, and zero fiber. Makes creamy soups and rice bowls flare-safe.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Shake can well before opening. Simmer with chicken bone broth and jasmine rice for an ultra-gentle comforting dinner.
